testflight.whats_new: Accessibility: play with VoiceOver (each square says what's on it, moves are announced), Voice Control ("Tap e4"), a keyboard or Switch Control, and the app follows your text size up to the largest accessibility sizes. Also: the widget now gets its data a new way, Share after every puzzle, the board on the right when sideways or folded (Menu > Left-handed layout to swap), no zoom on double tap. Please try VoiceOver and the largest text size.
